streams.name: Modernize Without Interrupting Critical Work
streams.description: A reconciled cohort moves to supported software with a rehearsed rollback and an approved legacy retirement decision.
outcomes: A reconciled cohort moves to supported software with a rehearsed rollback and an approved legacy retirement decision.

brickDependencies.description: Version system context, dependencies, quality requirements, technology tradeoffs and accepted exceptions before committing to an implementation.
Capture existing behavior, compare old and new outcomes, manage reversible cutover cohorts and collect retirement evidence for legacy applications.
Maintain versioned client-boundary mappings, contract tests, authentication adapters and retry limits; preserve the authoritative system for each business fact.
Validate schemas, transformations, lineage and freshness when building client data products; quarantine invalid batches and support bounded reprocessing.
Connect acceptance requirements to automated and manual test runs, defects and risk-based waivers; expose missing evidence before a release decision.
Create reproducible artifacts from reviewed changes, record provenance and promote approved versions through isolated environments with rollback metadata.
Create client-specific environments from versioned templates, restrict privileges and validate backup restoration, capacity and cost boundaries.
Correlate business-path health with runtime signals, route incidents by agreed coverage and track customer communication, recovery and follow-up actions.
